end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles, squares, and rectangles.
Explained that a rectangle has four sides and four corners.
Initially mixed up whether a tilted triangle still has three corners.
Corrected this later: a tilted triangle still has three straight sides and three corners.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes in different positions. Ayaan explained the four sides and four corners of a rectangle and later corrected the mix-up about a tilted triangle. At home, ask them to turn paper shapes around and count the sides and corners again.
